title: BoothReportWorkbookFormat
description: Output workbook format derived from configs/mahad report-abc.xlsx (Mahad AC-194, Maharashtra). One workbook per district batch. Column letters and header tokens mirror the example; Marathi headers replaced with Hindi equivalents for UP. Known unknown: the example's exact 'Average VS Difference' column-G and zone-threshold formula could not be recovered from the file, so both are defined here explicitly (see zone_rule).
output_dir: output/ (NEVER data/ - data/ is input storage only)

party_pair.party_b: Top non-BJP party by AC votes IN THAT ELECTION (fixed per AC; recorded per row in the Party B column and in Methods_Zones). Mirrors example using NCP for LS blocks and INC for VS blocks.
excluded: UNMAPPED (kept out of shares; listed in Methods)

sheets.name: All_ACs (single sheet for the whole batch, AC column; filter it for per-AC views)
sheets.title_row: Row 1: 'AGRA (AC 86-94) BOOTH ANALYSIS' (batch title; Party B varies per row, see Party B column)

columns.source: booth label '<ps> - <name>' (name as-is, legacy codes kept + flagged)
PS number in election E1 (blank if booth absent)
PS number in election E4 (added; example tracks 3 elections, we track 4)
mean of per-election (A-B) diffs over elections with data
newest election diff with data (documents direction; example col-G semantics unknown, TODO verify)
top non-BJP by AC votes in latest mapped election, fixed per AC (see Methods_Zones)

sheets.name: Booth_Votes
sheets.description: Mirrors example Sheet6/8 pattern: alternating booth row (label/address/serials/zone) and votes row (raw vote counts under serial columns + election totals). One block per AC, AC header row between blocks.
sheets.columns: Same A-F as AC sheets; votes row carries raw votes per election (C-F) and per-election totals in trailing columns

sheets.name: Turnout — REMOVED 2026-10-05 (user rule: extend sheets, never add sheets)
sheets.description: Was a separate sheet (E/M/F/O/T/TO% per election). Folded into All_ACs trailing columns (see below); sheet no longer written.

sheets.name: All_ACs trailing turnout columns (added 2026-10-05; ECI sheets + 2024 segment file)
sheets.description: Per election E=Electors, M=Male, F=Female, O=Other turnout, T=Total polled, TO%=T/E (blank = no data; 2024 Form20 has no gender split so M/F/O blank, T=polled, TO% blank). Final column '2024 AC Electors' = per-AC constant from the ECI assembly-segment file (booth electors unknown for 2024). O (Other gender, ~always 0) is NOT the opposition — opposition is Party B / B V.%.

sheets.name: All_ACs trailing 2017 modeled-demographics columns (added 2026-10-06; uprolls2017, 2017 vintage)
sheets.description: 36 data cols (religion shares, age avg/stddev overall + per religion, women%, revision/missing percents), each header-tagged '(modeled)', joined by (AC, zero-stripped PS) on the 2017 booth and shown on every row of that booth. KNOWN CALIBRATION PROBLEMS: parsi/christian/jain/sikh inflated vs Census, women% mean ~66%, age cells contain unparsed astronomic values. Treatment: R5 suppression (electors_17<200 blanks modeled cells), age gates (avg 15-100, sd 0-50), missing_percent_17 as quality signal. Admin cols (electors/missing/revision) exempt.
sheets.columns: electors_17 (modeled) | missing_percent_17 (modeled) | age_avg_17 (modeled) | age_stddev_17 (modeled) | age_muslim_avg_17 (modeled) | ... (all 36 data cols of uprolls2017 except id/ac_id_09/booth_id_17)

sheets.name: Zone_Counts
sheets.description: Mirrors example Sheet3: Type of Booths / Nos — counts of Safe/Favorable/Battlefield/Difficult/Data Not sufficient across the batch.

sheets.name: Methods_Zones
sheets.description: Documents zone_rule, party choices per AC, denominators, and every deviation from the example (spelling 'Defination' kept deliberately).

inputs: avg_diff (mean A-B over elections with data)
zone_rule.note: Thresholds are explicit here because the example file's own zone formula is not recoverable from its values. Tune SAFE_UP/DIFF_DOWN in Scripts/output_booth_report.py.

manual_only_sheets_in_example.caste_list: Example Sheet4 (community shares) is analyst input, not pipeline output.
manual_only_sheets_in_example.village_notes: Example Sheet7 (field intel, Marathi) is analyst input, not pipeline output.

denominators: Shares = party votes / polled (valid + NOTA). Voting.Diff = shareA - shareB in FRACTION points to match example scale (0.39 = 39%). Turnout TO% = polled-turnout-Total / electors (ECI sheets: M+F+O=T; blank where the source has no gender split, i.e. all of 2024).
never: No corrupt names (legacy codes flagged, never rewritten)
No fraud language (anomaly outputs stay statistical_outlier, separate pipeline)
